reason: The existing mapping provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. Article 15(5) supports vulnerability detection and response. Article 17 mandates a quality management system, which includes procedures for risk management (Art. 9) and post-market monitoring (Art. 72), covering patching and detection. Article 20 covers corrective actions and response. Article 73 covers serious incident reporting. Together, these provisions address all aspects of the control objective.
applicability_note: The control applies to all high-risk AI systems, with reporting obligations specifically for high-risk systems as defined in the AI Act.
challenge_comment: The mapping is comprehensive, covering the entire lifecycle from vulnerability management to incident response and reporting, as required by the AI Act for high-risk systems.
